title: brand
description: A brand pack: a party's colours and mark. It lives in brands/<id>/brand.md, next to its image files, and is copied into the model from the brand library. The Markdown text below the header holds usage notes, which are never shown or exported. A party uses it with a brand: line (or the capture sheet's Brand column).

id.description: The pack's id, the same as its folder name: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. globex.

version.description: The pack's version in the brand library, e.g. "2026.1". Put quotes around it, so a version such as 2026.10 keeps its last 0.

updated.description: The date the pack was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-03-01.

colours.description: The brand's colours. Colours must be hex values such as "#0b1f4d". Put quotes around them.

primary.description: The main brand colour. Colours must be hex values such as "#0b1f4d".

secondary.description: Used when the primary colour is too close to another party's. Colours must be hex values such as "#e0632a".

dark.description: The primary colour for dark mode. Left out, the engine derives one. Colours must be hex values such as "#6a86bc".

marks.description: Image files in the pack's own folder, written relative to it, e.g. mark.svg.

mark.description: A square SVG mark, shown next to the party's name, e.g. mark.svg.

mono.description: Optional one-colour version of the mark, e.g. mark-mono.svg.
